units: World logical pixels, before game rigid basis conversion
origin: Local pelvis/hip center; bike supplies a separately measured mount translation

semantics.hip_saddle: Pelvis bottom contact on actual saddle surface
semantics.hands: Grip centerline anchors; deliberate palm wrap is a declared contact exception
semantics.feet: Sole tangent points on actual top of foot support, not peg centerline

requirements: True straddled bent legs and bent arms, not an upright walking sprite
One depth target for rider and bike; same interpolated pose and yaw
Actual body, wheel envelope and contact checks on each bike/profile/avatar combination
Existing avatar identity and frozen standing approvals remain unchanged
limits: Initial Explorer prototype only; not universal avatar fit
No normal activation, AI occupancy, failure fallback or animation qualified
Body dimensions and mounts must be measured; this contract does not prove clearance
